cells.title: Park a cell on a question and answer it

It refuses an empty question or a cell that is capped, dropped or already parked. `bee cells answer --id <cell> --answer <text>` refuses a cell that is not parked; otherwise it logs the answer as a decision BEFORE it writes the cell (tags `cells` and `slp`, both already in docs/decisions/taxonomy.json, the way dissent.rs does, so the taxonomy file never changes; the decision text names the cell id and quotes the question and the answer), appends the new decision id to the cell's `decisions`, stamps answer, answer_decision and answered_at on the open park entry, and sets status `open`.
